pub type Raw
pub enum LookupOutcome
  Resolved
  Invalid
  Unavailable
  UnsupportedMapping
  Forbidden
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum ManifestOutcome
  Resolved
  NotFound
  Invalid
  Unavailable
  UnsupportedMapping
  Forbidden
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 6]
pub const RESOLVER_OPERATIONS: [&str; 2]
pub const REGISTRY_OPERATIONS: [&str; 3]
pub struct Ref
  registry: String
  repo: String
  revision: String
  quant: String
  file: String
  credential: String
pub struct LookupResult
  outcome: LookupOutcome
  request: Option<OAImported0>
pub struct ManifestResult
  outcome: ManifestOutcome
  manifest: Option<OAImported1>
  resolved_revision: String
pub fn encode(v: &Ref) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Ref, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait ModelResolver
  type Error
  fn resolve(&self, reference: Ref) -> Result<LookupResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ModelResolverClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait ModelManifest
  type Error
  fn resolve(&self, reference: Ref) -> Result<ManifestResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ModelManifestClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub fn encode_ref_document(v: &Ref) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Refusal>
pub fn decode_ref_document(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Ref, Refusal>
pub fn encode_lookup_result_document(v: &LookupResult) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Refusal>
pub fn decode_lookup_result_document(data: &[u8]) -> Result<LookupResult, Refusal>
pub fn encode_manifest_result_document(v: &ManifestResult) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Refusal>
pub fn decode_manifest_result_document(data: &[u8]) -> Result<ManifestResult, Refusal>
pub mod internal
  pub fn decode_ref_at(data: &[u8], depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(super::Ref, usize), super::Refusal>
  pub fn check_ref(v: &super::Ref, depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(), super::Refusal>
  pub fn encode_ref_at(v: &super::Ref, depth: i32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, super::Refusal>
  pub fn decode_lookup_result_at(data: &[u8], depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(super::LookupResult, usize), super::Refusal>
  pub fn check_lookup_result(v: &super::LookupResult, depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(), super::Refusal>
  pub fn encode_lookup_result_at(v: &super::LookupResult, depth: i32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, super::Refusal>
  pub fn decode_manifest_result_at(data: &[u8], depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(super::ManifestResult, usize), super::Refusal>
  pub fn check_manifest_result(v: &super::ManifestResult, depth: i32, limit: i32) -> Result<(), super::Refusal>
  pub fn encode_manifest_result_at(v: &super::ManifestResult, depth: i32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, super::Refusal>
